certification_basis.raw_reference: For the basic PA-34-220T (Seneca V) aeroplane the applicable certification basis is FAR 23. For details on the applicable FAR 23 amendments see A.V., note 6. For PA-34-220T (Seneca V) aeroplanes equipped with the factory installed Avidyne Entegra System option the additional certification basis for installation specific items only is CS-23 as defined in CRI-A01, issue 1, or later revision (for details on applicable paragraphs see A.V., note 7). For PA-34-220T (Seneca V) aeroplanes equipped with the factory installed Garmin G600/GNS430W/GWX68 and KTA-870 option the additional certification basis for installation specific items only is CS-23 as defined in CRI-A01-G600, release1, issue 1, or later revision (for details on applicable paragraphs see A.V., note 7). For PA-34-220T (Seneca V) aeroplanes equipped with the factory installed Garmin G1000 Integrated Avionics System option the additional certification basis for installation specific items only is CS-23 as defined in CRI A-01 G1000, issue 2, or later revision (for details on applicable paragraphs see A.V., note 7).

For PA-34-220T (Seneca V) aeroplanes equipped with the factory installed Garmin GFC700 AFCS option the additional certification basis for installation specific items only is CS-23 as defined in CRI-A01 (for details on applicable paragraphs see A.V., note 7). For PA-34-220T (Seneca V) aeroplanes equipped with the Piper factory installed optional Garmin International G1000NXi Phase I/II installed in accordance with Piper Top Drawing 107200-004, the additional certification basis for installation specific items only is CS-23 as defined in A.V. note 7).
